title: SWF: SceneAndFrameLabelData tag (tag 86) encoding
description: Test that a multi-scene FlashDocument (doc.scenes.length > 1) produces SceneAndFrameLabelData (tag 86). Verify: (1) tag 86 appears for multi-scene documents, (2) scene count matches doc.scenes.length, (3) scene names are encoded as null-terminated strings, (4) frame offsets are correct cumulative frame counts, (5) single-scene docs may omit tag 86 (optional).
